fields.description: The version this lesson belongs to. A lesson is never shared between versions — cloning a version clones its lessons, keeping their keys.
fields.label: Course Version

fields.description: Which chapter of the version this sits under. Matched against the chapter's stable key, not its position.
fields.label: Chapter Key

fields.description: Stable identifier, copied verbatim when a version is cloned. This is what lets a minor edit keep a learner exactly where they were rather than resetting them to lesson one.
fields.label: Lesson Key

fields.description: Roughly how long this lesson takes. Summed into the course estimate at publish.
fields.label: Estimated Minutes

fields.description: The lesson, block by block, in the order a learner meets them.
fields.label: Blocks

fields.description: Draw this many questions at random from the pool below. Leave at 0 to ask all of them.
fields.label: Questions To Ask

fields.description: Score needed to pass this lesson's quiz. Leave at 0 to use the course setting.
fields.label: Passing Score

fields.description: Ask the questions in a different order for each learner.
fields.label: Shuffle Questions

fields.description: Shuffle the answer options too, so "it's the third one" cannot be passed around.
fields.label: Shuffle Options

fields.description: Let learners ask the author a question from this lesson. Answers can be made visible to everyone who takes it afterwards.
fields.label: Allow Learner Questions

fields.description: Paste the lesson's script or the video's transcript. Used to draft quiz questions. A transcript with timings (WebVTT) additionally enables checkpoint-timestamp suggestions — without timings the model would have to invent them.
fields.label: Transcript

fields.description: The exact payload the player renders, built at publish with every correct answer stripped out. Machine-written; editing it by hand does nothing useful.
fields.label: Published Content (JSON)

fields.description: The answer key for this lesson as published. Held at permission level 1 so it is not readable by the roles that take the course, and it is never included in any learner-facing response.
fields.label: Answer Key (JSON)
